readme:
# DBA.dk Scraper

Scrape classified listings from [DBA.dk](https://www.dba.dk), Denmark's largest online marketplace (Schibsted group).

## How it works

1. Go to [dba.dk](https://www.dba.dk) and search for what you need
2. Copy the search URL or just enter a keyword
3. Paste it into the actor input
4. Run the actor

The actor extracts all listings matching your search, with automatic pagination.

## Use with AI Agents (MCP)

Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client — Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom agents.

**Apify MCP server URL:**

```
https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/dba-dk-scraper
```

**Example prompt once connected:**

> "Use `dba-dk-scraper` to scrape company data from dba dk. Return results as a table."

Clients that support dynamic tool discovery (Claude.ai, VS Code) will receive the full input schema automatically via `add-actor`.

## Output

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `title` | Listing title |
| `price` / `currency` | Price in DKK |
| `location` | City or area |
| `latitude` / `longitude` | GPS coordinates |
| `brand` | Brand name |
| `condition` | Item condition (detail mode) |
| `image_url` / `image_urls` | Images |
| `posted_at` | Publication date |
| `source_url` | Link to listing on DBA.dk |

## Pricing

No start fee -- pay only for results:

| Event | Cost |
|-------|------|
| Listing (basic) | $0.003 |
| Listing (with details) | $0.005 |

**100 listings = $0.30** (basic) or **$0.50** (with details)

## Examples

### Search by keyword
```json
{
  "searchQuery": "iphone",
  "maxResults": 50
}
```

### Multiple searches in one run
```json
{
  "searchQueries": ["iphone", "samsung galaxy", "cykel"],
  "maxResults": 100,
  "maxResultsPerQuery": 50
}
```

### With full details
```json
{
  "searchQuery": "macbook",
  "maxResults": 100,
  "includeDetails": true
}
```
